signature: SUBROUTINE ZPTRFS( UPLO, N, NRHS, D, E, DF, EF, B, LDB, X, LDX,

params.name: uplo
N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The n real diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A.

params.name: e
params.reference: The (n-1) off-diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix A (see `UPLO`).

params.name: DF
params.reference: The n diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D from the factorization computed by ZPTTRF.

params.name: EF
params.reference: The (n-1) off-diagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal factor U or L from the factorization computed by ZPTTRF (see `UPLO`).

params.name: B
params.reference: The right hand side matrix B.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: X
params.reference: On entry, the solution matrix X, as computed by ZPTTRS. On exit, the improved solution matrix X.

params.name: ldx
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array X. $\mathrm{LDX} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: FERR
params.reference: The forward error bound for each solution vector `X(j)` (the j-th column of the solution matrix X). If XTRUE is the true solution corresponding to `X(j)`, `FERR(j)` is an estimated upper bound for the magnitude of the largest element in (`X(j)` - XTRUE) divided by the magnitude of the largest element in `X(j)`.

params.name: BERR
params.reference: The componentwise relative backward error of each solution vector `X(j)` (i.e., the smallest relative change in any element of A or B that makes `X(j)` an exact solution).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
